usageNotes: Returns all key-value entries stored in the Ceph configuration database (mon config store), which supersedes the on-disk ceph.conf for runtime settings. Use this to audit active Ceph tunables across sections (global, osd, mon, mgr, etc.) and determine whether a setting can be changed without a daemon restart via the can_update_at_runtime field. The target node must be online and have Ceph configured; the caller needs either Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit at the root path.

examples.summary: Retrieve all Ceph config DB entries from node pve1

tips: Entries with level 'dev' are developer/internal knobs — avoid modifying them in production.
The 'mask' field scopes a setting to a specific host or device class (e.g. 'class:ssd'); an empty mask means the setting applies globally within its section.
All values are returned as strings regardless of their underlying type — cast appropriately when comparing or computing.
This reflects the live mon config store, not the on-disk ceph.conf; the two can differ if settings were applied via 'ceph config set' after initial deployment.
